% Invented combined fixture: every piece of frame furniture in one deck —
% a \newenvironment wrapper with an argument, \centering, columns with
% declared widths, overlays (item specs, \uncover, \pause), and speaker
% notes. Nothing here derives from any private document.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}

\newenvironment{callout}[1]{\textbf{#1:} }{}

\title{Frame Furniture}
\author{Pat Placeholder}
\date{}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\begin{frame}{Wrapped and centred}
\begin{callout}{Note}
wrappers keep their argument.
\end{callout}

{\centering This line is centred.\par}
\note{Wrappers and centering share this slide.}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Figure beside text}
\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.55\textwidth}
The wider column carries the prose, set to its own measure, wrapping
where the narrow measure says it must.
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.4\textwidth}
\centering
The narrow column.
\end{column}
\end{columns}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Step by step}
\begin{itemize}
\item<1-> First beat.
\item<2-> Second beat.
\end{itemize}

\pause
\uncover<3>{The closing line.}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
